picks.why: Jabil trades at 10.2x forward with a 6% FCF yield and 29% revenue growth, and was the best server name on five days (-11.2%) as server makers start raising prices. It is a cash-generative way to own AI build-out demand without the accounting and financing questions now hanging over compute.
picks.risk: If vendor-financed AI orders are cut, its thin 5% operating margin leaves little cushion.

picks.why: MasTec is the only shortlist name in an overweight segment, at 11.8x forward with 30% revenue growth from transmission and data-centre construction. It is a direct play on grid as the binding constraint, now 67% off its high.
picks.risk: A 67% drawdown and 5% operating margin may signal company-specific execution or margin problems rather than just the AI sell-off.
